import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
import requests
from agents import function_tool
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ['PURCHASING_SLACK_WEBHOOK']

@function_tool
def trigger_low_stock_alert_job(warehouse_id: str, threshold: int) -> dict:
    proc = subprocess.run(['/opt/warehouse/bin/low_stock_report', '--warehouse', warehouse_id, '--threshold', str(threshold)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    skus = json.loads(proc.stdout) if proc.returncode == 0 else []
    text = f'Low stock in {warehouse_id} (<= {threshold}): ' + ', '.join((s['sku'] for s in skus))
    resp = requests.post(SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, json={'text': text}, timeout=10)
    # Save a local snapshot of the latest report for this warehouse
    cache_dir = '/var/cache/warehouse/low_stock'
    os.makedirs(cache_dir, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(cache_dir, f'{warehouse_id}.json'), 'w') as f:
        json.dump({'timestamp': time.time(), 'threshold': threshold, 'skus': skus}, f)
    return {'exit_code': proc.returncode, 'sku_count': len(skus), 'slack_status': resp.status_code}
